title: Carthage Falls: The End of an Empire
hook: Part 10. Night falls over Carthage, but the city refuses to surrender.
full_narration: Part 10. Night falls over Carthage, but the city refuses to surrender. Roman siege towers loom against the battered walls. [[pause:0.4]] Flames crawl across rooftops as defenders fight in the shadows. Scipio Aemilianus watches, silent, as the city breaks beneath his command. [[voice:tense]] The streets become silent—only collapsing stone and smoke remain. Roman legions move through the ruins, searching for signs of resistance. [[pause:0.6]] Carthaginian survivors slip into alleys, faces lit by firelight. The sky glows red as centuries of power vanish in a single night. By dawn, Carthage is erased—146 BCE marks its final breath. [[voice:low]] The city’s ashes belong to Rome, but its legend endures. The world is changed. Rome rises from Carthage’s ruins. The story echoes through the ages. [[pause:0.8]] Follow for the next dark history story.

youtube_description: Night falls over Carthage for the last time. Roman siege towers press against battered walls as flames crawl through the city. By dawn, Carthage is erased—146 BCE marks its final breath. Rome claims the ashes, but Carthage’s legend refuses to die. The world is changed forever.
